sections.name: directory
sections.notes: OPTIONAL (v1.1+): a section with repeat:'per-item' renders its element once per bound data item (see data_binding).

data_binding.$comment: OPTIONAL (v1.1+). Present on directory/list templates that render a repeating element over consumer-supplied items.
data_binding.notes: Maps element fields to fields on each consumer item. item_key identifies the item for item-scoped actions.

marker_fills.$comment: OPTIONAL (v1.1+). Fills a NEUTRAL element marker with concrete controls. THIS is where a domain template (not the generic element) says what buttons exist.

action_contract.$comment: OPTIONAL (v1.1+). The abstract action handles this template emits. The CONSUMING collection maps each handle to one of its own flows; the brand book never names the flow.

surfaces.$comment: OPTIONAL (v1.1+). Where this template can render. Templates with interactive actions declare cowork_interactive; export_formats lists static targets.

cowork_interactive.notes: In-app interactive render; action buttons emit their handle back to the session.

surfaces.export_notes: Static renders omit action buttons unless an interactive export is requested.

slots.name: item-logo
slots.notes: OPTIONAL (v1.1+): per-item slot, supplied per bound item.

$notes: Slot VALUES are never stored here — consumers supply them at compose time from their own context (e.g., a client-intelligence instance's branding/ dir).
Starter element slugs: cover-page, header, footer, table, list, callout, title-block, metadata-block, chart-style, kpi-card, toc, section-divider, code-block, quote.

v1.1+ interactive-template fields (data_binding, marker_fills, action_contract, surfaces, section.repeat, item-scoped slots) are all OPTIONAL and back-compatible: a plain document template omits them. See internal/conventions.md > 'Interactive templates & action markers'.
